source_grid.support: current equal-prior BRAN2016, OSCAR v2 Final and GLORYS12/WAVERYS Pléiades transport-family grid on the official FL400 seventh-arc reference; 5 NM along-arc and cross-arc grid to plus or minus 100 NM

correlation_variants.role: publication-trace local energy with no additional periodic-airgun suppression or masking
primary filter with dilated observed-centre score exclusion
stronger-filter sensitivity with dilated observed-centre score exclusion

unfiltered_acquisition.null: independent panel-wise IAAFT surrogates of H08S publication pressure; maximum unfiltered energy correlation over the complete geometry-plus-offset search
unfiltered_acquisition.generic_template_status: secondary compatibility with the existing illustrative two-part pulse; never used for candidate selection

filtered_acquisition.null: independent panel-wise IAAFT surrogates of the held-out-selected rank-8 H08S residual local-energy score; maximum correlation over the complete geometry-plus-offset search
filtered_acquisition.selection: rank 8 is the pre-existing held-out control choice: it preserves substantially more synthetic coincident transient amplitude than rank 20 while still reducing periodic-cycle RMS

nulls: permute pulse-energy marks within each H08S panel while retaining pulse times, H01W data and the complete grid search
circularly time-slide the H01W feature series within each publication panel while retaining the H08S marks and the complete grid search
pulse_conditioned_acquisition.statistic: Fisher combination of conservative empirical upper-tail fractions for H08S core-minus-shoulder pressure-squared exposure and the predicted H01W four-second local-energy maximum; significance is determined only from complete-search empirical null maxima

kadri_preferred_distance_control.source: Kadri 2024 p. 13: seventh-arc distance from H01W in the 306.18 degree direction

interpretation: The correlation is Pearson correlation between panel-wise standardised local-energy scores after shifting by the point-source distance difference. It is a descriptive scan of already-filtered publication vectors. A source cell only selects an interstation lag, so maxima are range-difference contours rather than unique locations.
